sourceQualifications: The article title and introduction identify 2025 Royalty WWE, but the Autographs and Relics and Collector’s Takeaway paragraphs say 2026. Preserve this inconsistency without relabeling the checklist.

candidateReconciliation: The two existing batch-5 WrestleMania Patch Autographs 1/1 candidate statements were re-read and joined only to the exact 2025 physical program; the source prints 31 subjects versus 50 in the guide. Other newly read ladders require explicit family joins.
remainingGaps: Exhaustive parallel numbering remains unverified. No generic /99-to-1/1 Superfractor ladder or unreviewed family color limits are inferred.

Regalia Relics Signatures wording joins the physical REGALIA RELIC SIGNATURES program only. Its Silver /10 and Green /5 are guide-only: the PDF has Gold instead of Silver and no Green category. Gold remains unnumbered.

The guide describes 50 WrestleMania Patch subjects and 50 Regalia Relics Signatures subjects, while the physical checklist prints 31 and 42. Preserve both counts without inventing missing subjects or individual parallel eligibility.
The article mixes 2025 and 2026 labels; exact joins are scoped to its 2025 title, introduction, landing link and matching physical families.
The odds-only Liquid Gold program has no verified roster join. Its ratio remains separate; no Silver roster or numbering is inferred.
